blocks.title: Function banana aur bulana
blocks.text: Function def keyword, function ke naam aur qausain se banta hai jin mein parameters ho sakte hain; is ka jism indent hota hai. Function invoke (call) karne ka matlab us ka naam le kar us se kaam karwana hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.prompt: Python mein function banane ke liye kaunsa keyword hai (MCQ 8)?

items: def name(parameters): indent wala jism; naam se bulayein: greet("Ali").
